conventions.append_only: Additive changes only. New entities get new IDs from the next free number. New relationship types and entity types may be appended in minor schema versions.
conventions.merge_path: Each research package (BCI-001 … MUSIC-001) delivers entities.json / relationships.json fragments. On merge: (1) dedupe against existing entities via name+aliases (case-insensitive); (2) mint new IDs only for genuinely new entities; (3) keep the surviving ID on merge and record retired IDs; (4) validate with validate.py before commit.
conventions.no_invention: Never invent facts, dates, addresses, or relationships. Mark Provisional rather than omitting; omit rather than inventing.
conventions.legacy_ids: Grandfathered pre-schema IDs (per-*/org-*/place-*) from the 2026-10 Freeman research batch. These IDs are published on the website and are never renumbered. Registered here so validate.py accepts them; no new legacy IDs may be minted.
conventions.negative_assertions: Claims like 'no physical headquarters' or 'no employees' require evidence and an expiration/review date, because they can change. Mark Provisional with next_review_date set.

description: Seed schema for the CultureTechLens Black Cultural Knowledge Graph: the long-term data backbone for Black cultural-intelligence infrastructure rooted in Chicago. The seven flagship research packages (BCI-001, BMI-002, BPM-003, SCI-004, BVM-005, PLACE-001, MUSIC-001) merge into this graph as they complete. Design is append-only: minor versions may add entity types, relationship types, and optional fields; existing records are never destructively rewritten and IDs are never reused.

Address.description: A specific street address, intersection, or corridor. Only include when location is documented — never invent street numbers.

Event.description: A dated occurrence: founding, opening, riot, election, parade, demolition, etc.

Institution.description: A named institution: label, studio, museum, cultural center, bank, company HQ as institution.

Migration.description: A migration flow (reserved for research-package use; no seed instances).

Neighborhood.description: A Chicago neighborhood or community area.

Organization.description: A nonprofit, movement, association, or civic organization.

Person.description: An individual, or a named group/ensemble (use subtype 'group').

Policy.description: A law, ordinance, covenant, or policy (reserved for research-package use; no seed instances).

Publication.description: A newspaper, magazine, or periodical title.

Technology.description: A technology that shaped cultural practice (reserved; no seed instances).

Venue.description: A performance, nightlife, or gathering venue.

Work.description: A creative work: song, album, book, play, film.

Practice.description: A living cultural practice: a dance, ritual, craft, or social form sustained by a community.

Locality.description: A city, town, stadium, or other named place outside the Chicago-neighborhood scope.

field_guidance.aliases: Array of alternate names/spellings; may be empty. Critical for deduplication.
field_guidance.description: One factual line. No invented dates.
field_guidance.era: Free-text era, e.g. '1950s–1970s', '1916–1970', 'contemporary'. Use broad ranges over precise dates you cannot verify.
field_guidance.name: Canonical display name.
field_guidance.project_ids: Non-empty array; at least one registered project ID.
field_guidance.sources: Non-empty array of {citation, primary}. citation is a short human-readable reference; primary is true for archival/government/institutional records, era newspapers, oral histories, and false for encyclopedias, retrospectives, reputable secondary journalism.
field_guidance.relationship_start_date: YYYY-MM-DD the relationship began; null when undocumented. Never invent.
field_guidance.relationship_end_date: YYYY-MM-DD the relationship ended; null if ongoing or unknown.
field_guidance.relationship_confidence: high | medium | low — the author's confidence in the edge.
field_guidance.relationship_evidence_id: CTL-EVD-* ID when the edge maps to a package evidence record; null otherwise (evidence prose still required).

id_scheme.entity: CTL-E-NNNN, zero-padded (seed occupies CTL-E-0001 through CTL-E-0300; continue at CTL-E-0301)
rules: IDs are assigned once and never changed.
IDs are never reused, even if an entity is retired.
When duplicate entities are merged, the surviving entity keeps its ID; the retired ID is noted in the survivor's record and never reassigned.
Research packages merging in later must mint new IDs from the next free number; they must never renumber seed entities.

relationship_rules: Seed relationships are verified-only: every edge must be traceable to evidence. When in doubt, leave it out.
from/to must be valid entity IDs present in entities.json.
type must be one of relationship_types names, and the endpoint types must satisfy from_types/to_types.
evidence is 1–2 sentences stating what documents the relationship; source is a short citation.
verification is Verified or Provisional; Provisional edges must still have real evidence, only with some uncertainty.

relationship_types.name: served_by
relationship_types.description: Neighborhood or locality was served by the church's ministry or congregation. Inverse of served_neighborhood.

title: CTL Black Cultural Knowledge Graph — Schema

verification_rules.Provisional: The entity is believed real and correctly described, but some detail (dates, exact address, attribution) is uncertain or single-sourced. Prefer Provisional over omitting a valuable entity — but NEVER invent facts, dates, addresses, or relationships to fill gaps.
verification_rules.Verified: The entity's existence and core facts are well documented in reliable sources. Use for entities with solid sourcing.
verification_rules.forbidden: Do not manufacture claims, dates, addresses, or relationships. Do not infer an occupant from an address without evidence. Separate documented evidence from interpretation.

id_namespaces.note: New namespaces apply to NEW records minted from 2026-10-05 forward. Entity IDs continue as CTL-E-NNNN (never renumber published IDs); legacy slug IDs (per-*/org-*/place-*) are grandfathered per legacy_ids.

source_hierarchy.name: primary government record
source_hierarchy.description: IRS, Secretary of State, court filings, official government data.

source_hierarchy.name: organization-controlled record
source_hierarchy.description: The org's own filed documents, website, authorized statements.

source_hierarchy.name: reputable independent reporting
source_hierarchy.description: Established newsrooms and journals with editorial control.

source_hierarchy.name: structured directory
source_hierarchy.description: Candid, Charity Navigator, Crunchbase, ProPublica — structured, editorially light.

notes.conflicting_claim_ids: CTL-CLM-* IDs making the incompatible assertions.
notes.competing_sources: Array of {source, value, tier} — one per variant.
notes.stronger_source: Which source wins and why, per the source hierarchy.
notes.review_date: YYYY-MM-DD the conflict must be re-examined.

notes.date_precision: day | month | year | unknown — never imply false precision.
notes.participants: Array of entity IDs with a role in the event; [] if none documented.
notes.place: Entity ID or place string; null when not documented.
notes.consequence: One sentence on what the event changed; null when not documented.

notes.entity_id: Every geography record links to an entity. A PO Box is a mailing_address, never a physical_location or operating location.

verification_timestamps.note: next_review_date defaults to last_verified + 1 year when not set.

package_standard.rule: A package receives COMPLETE status only when acceptance-test.py exits 0.
